text: I will never come again. Doctor has never improved. No sympathy no smile. I told the nurse I tested Covid. The queue was 1 hour long. When I saw the doctor, he told me his clinic has no Covid medication. I need to go hospital. Why the nurse didn't tell me when I registered. What the hell.

This was a terrible experience. I'd like the Medical Council to investigate and seriously review the doctor's license. This doctor didn't give the patient the attention he deserved. He was constantly looking at the screen, playing with the stock market.

A patient came in with knee pain, but the doctor didn't examine, palpate, or even look at the knee at all. He just looked briefly and prescribed medication without properly assessing the condition.

The patient also reported chills, but the doctor didn't take her temperature until she asked for it. This is a basic medical examination standard that should not be neglected.

To be honest, I don't recommend going there. Most locals avoid the clinic because they know the doctor's work style. They prioritize money over patient safety.

I've wasted my time, money, and mental health from this unimpressive service.

The staff at the counter were all lovely, except for the doctor. Their demeanor was completely unprofessional. They were sarcastic and disrespectful to the patient. Patients are there to see a doctor because they're unwell; a doctor's job is to examine and explain things to the patient, not to use sarcastic or insulting language. A doctor should have more professional ethics. Patients are paying for their treatment, not asking for free medicine.

The doctor was terrible. My child had eye pain, and the doctor didn't even look into my child's eyes. He just said it was conjunctivitis (pink eye). My child has been taking medication for a week, but it hasn't improved and is even more painful. We had to go to another clinic. Another doctor said it was a corneal ulcer. Luckily, my child isn't blind. Dr. Narong just sat there with his head down, not even looking into my child's eyes to see how much pain he was in. I'm so frustrated. I will never go back to that doctor again, no matter how sick I am.

I wasn't very happy with the doctor. Their tone was abrupt and they could have spoken more politely. It was as if they were going to eat the patient's head off. If they improved their communication and smiled at patients, it would be much better. The treatment itself was also rushed; it was over in less than 3 minutes. They discussed the possible causes, possibilities, and symptoms, but didn't make a clear diagnosis. The assistant at the counter was helpful. However, the price was quite expensive for the treatment.

Is this really a doctor? I saw him sitting there looking at his stock market screen the whole time. The examination room was dark too. He didn't seem interested in treating patients at all.
Don't come here, go somewhere else.

I was only in the clinic for a short time. The service was good.
But the doctor wearing the gown should be a little more reserved. I went in alone, and when I saw the doctor, he told me to sit down, so I sat. Before I could even finish sitting, he grabbed my arm and squeezed it two or three times to check my blood pressure in a rather casual way, and then he was done. It took less than a minute, I think.
And he was rude too. 😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡
The doctor was excellent. Very kind and polite. He explained the symptoms of my illness very well.

text: Every review is true. The two women at the counter were very polite, but the doctor was terrible. She was uninterested, inattentive during the examination, and gave no advice. She just told us to take the medicine and apply the ointment, speaking as if the patients were begging for it. I don't know if she's even a real doctor. If she lacks professional ethics, she should close the clinic and do something else. Everyone who is sick wants treatment; they are determined to get better, not crawling on their knees begging for medicine. If she reads these reviews, she should improve herself before she loses all her customers. People are coming to her because of her.
Today I went to the doctor and got great answers to my questions. It was worth the price and cleared up my doubts. The doctor explained everything well. Thank you.
